WntDisclosure.title: WNT disclosure
WntDisclosure.description: The annual WNT-verantwoording for one topfunctionaris for one calendar year (Wet normering topinkomens, BWBR0032249). One row per (topfunctionaris, year) carrying the hand-entered total WNT-bezoldiging for that year and a two-state concept -> gepubliceerd publication lifecycle. The set of a year's WntDisclosure rows IS that year's WNT-verantwoording -- there is no separate aggregate report schema (wnt-disclosure design.md D2). totalCompensation is hand-entered by finance; this app computes and aggregates nothing (design.md D3).

publiceren.description: Publishes the disclosure as part of the year's WNT-verantwoording. No guard -- publication is a plain per-row status transition (wnt-disclosure design.md D2).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Reference to the topfunctionaris Employee this annual disclosure reports on. The referenced Employee's wntTopfunctionaris and wntUitzonderingReden gate the nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding check.

year.title: Year
year.description: The calendar year this disclosure covers, in YYYY. The year's full WNT-verantwoording is every WntDisclosure row carrying this year (design.md D2).

totalCompensation.title: Total compensation
totalCompensation.description: The total WNT-bezoldiging for this topfunctionaris for the year, in whole euro (salary + vacation allowance + year-end bonus + taxable expense reimbursements + pension contribution, per the WNT's own compensation definition). Hand-entered by finance -- this app computes and aggregates nothing across payroll runs (design.md D3). Compared against the WNT-norm's annual figure (EUR 262.000 in 2026) by nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding.

status.title: Status
status.description: Publication lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> gepubliceerd).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this WntDisclosure is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PensionFiling convention).
